clues.text: This city sits on the wide Danube River in the middle of Europe. Green woods and the first hills of the Alps rise at its edge.
clues.narrowing: Rules out places away from big rivers; puts the player on the Danube in central Europe.

source.quote: It sits on the Danube, and is traversed by the highly regulated Wienfluss (Vienna River).

clues.text: Summers here are warm, with showers that come and go. Winters turn cold and dry, and snow falls less than it once did.
clues.narrowing: Rules out wet winter lands and deep snow lands; keeps a cold, dry winter city.

source.quote: Winters are relatively dry and fairly cold with daily mean temperatures around or somewhat above the freezing point.

clues.text: In 1804, this city became the capital of a brand new empire. It kept that rank for each state that rose from the empire later.
clues.narrowing: Shrinks the list to cities made the capital of a new empire in 1804.

source.quote: In 1804, during the Napoleonic Wars , Vienna became the capital of the newly formed Austrian Empire .

clues.text: Mozart lived and worked in this city, and so did Beethoven. Their fame made it a top home of great music in Europe.
clues.narrowing: Nearly decisive: Mozart and Beethoven both lived and worked in this one city.

source.quote: Vienna is renowned for its rich musical heritage, having been home to many celebrated classical composers, including Ludwig van Beethoven, Johannes Brahms, Anton Bruckner, Joseph Haydn, Gustav Mahler, Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart

clues.text: This city is the political heart of Austria. The leaders who run the whole land meet and work here.
clues.narrowing: Confirms it: the political centre of Austria, where its government runs the country.

source.quote: Vienna is the cultural, economic, and political centre of the country

reveal.blurb: Roman soldiers built a camp called Vindobona by the river in the first century. In 1804 the city became the capital of a new empire, and great composers made it a home of music. Palaces and grand halls still line its old streets today. Vienna is the capital of Austria.
